findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “As a man has a cause…” / corresponding translation paragraph
findings.source_quote: “When a man has a cause set before him, he can endure almost anything.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “사람 앞에 분명한 대의가 놓여 있으면 거의 무엇이든 견딜 수 있습니다.” with “사람 앞에 대의가 놓여 있으면 거의 무엇이든 견딜 수 있습니다.” The source does not say the cause must be clear.
findings.translation_quote: “사람 앞에 분명한 대의가 놓여 있으면 거의 무엇이든 견딜 수 있습니다.”

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “As Saul reluctantly consents…” / corresponding translation paragraph
findings.source_quote: “And David put them off him –1 Samuel 17:39,”
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the reference in this quotation from “사무엘상 17:39” to “사무엘상 17:39,” preserving the source punctuation and reference number; the translation currently does not add a verse, but the closing comma belongs after the reference in the source quotation.

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “As Saul reluctantly consents…” / corresponding translation paragraph
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “그리고 대신 돌 다섯 개를 골랐습니다” with “대신 돌 다섯 개를 골랐습니다.” The source makes David the subject of choosing the stones; the current sentence can read as though Saul chose them.

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “Goliath had automatically assumed…” / corresponding translation paragraph
findings.source_quote: “at six or seven revolutions per second, David’s sling had the stopping power of a 45 mm handgun”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the printed measurement faithfully as “45mm 권총”; do not change millimeters to “밀리미터” in a way that suggests a 45-millimeter handgun. For example: “45mm 권총에 맞먹는 저지력을 냈고”.
Correct the name to the source’s “Dorcus” rendering in Korean, such as “도르쿠스에게는 바늘이 있었고;”. Do not substitute “도르가,” which is a different spelling/name form from the printed source.
